description:
Château de Nieuil was built on the site of an older medieval fortress on the estate of François I, of which only a tower survives today. The present château was rebuilt in 1883 and has remained in the same family for generations, now operating as a hotel with its own vegetable garden supplying the restaurant.

Today its 7 rooms plus 3 suites (10 total) are individually decorated, some with garden-view balconies, all within the rebuilt 1883 château.

The survival of only a single tower from the original medieval fortress means the château guests see and stay in today is substantially an 1883 reconstruction, rather than the original castle from the era of François I.

The estate's documented royal association with François I ties Nieuil to 16th-century French royal history, even though most of the visible building dates to the much later 19th-century rebuild.

The château's continuous ownership by the same family for generations, alongside its own vegetable garden supplying the restaurant, gives Nieuil a genuinely working estate character rather than a purely commercial hotel operation.

Note: this property's Booking.com listing currently displays under a glitched name ("Château Optical Center, Nieuil") due to a data-sync error on Booking's side — confirmed via direct verification that the address and listing description match this genuine historic château; it is not a different business.

The château's position in Nieuil, Charente, gives guests staying here access to Angoulême and the wider Charente countryside.

faqs.question: Is the château guests stay in today the original medieval castle?
faqs.answer: No — only a tower survives from the original medieval fortress on the estate of François I. The present château dates to an 1883 rebuild.

faqs.answer: A confirmed data-sync glitch on Booking.com's side displays the listing as "Château Optical Center" — verified to be the same genuine historic château at 205 Rue François Perry, Nieuil, not a different business.

faqs.question: Are all the rooms at Château de Nieuil within the château?
faqs.answer: Yes — all 7 rooms and 3 suites are within the rebuilt 1883 château.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In Nieuil, Charente, Nouvelle-Aquitaine.

**Rooms & rates:** 7 rooms + 3 suites, all within the rebuilt 1883 château; from about €100 per night.

**On-site:** Outdoor pool, restaurant sourced from the property's own vegetable garden, gardens.

**Good to know:** The medieval castle that originally stood here was largely lost; only a tower survives, and the château guests see and stay in today dates to an 1883 rebuild. The property's Booking.com listing currently displays under a glitched name ("Château Optical Center") — the affiliate link still routes correctly to this property.

**Combine with:** Angoulême and the Charente countryside, within driving distance.
